name: Kobito Ou no Kikan
source:
High school student Nomura finds a world of little people living in his very own bedroom. He meets the Little Queen and becomes involved in a political war of the tiny kingdom.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076870.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
高中生野村在自己的卧室里发现了一个小人物的世界。他遇到了小女王，并卷入了这个小王国的政治战争。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076870.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
